race.comment: Tough with many off the chances drawn out. TAUTO BAR (11) is a three starts maiden who gave a sight on heavy ground last time and finished runner-up at Wodonga. has the pace to cross early and expected to take catching again. THE COMEDIAN (4) turned in a nice debut when raced on pace at Sale and boxed on well for fifth. Has upside but a very wide draw to overcome. TANABATA (14) is a Waller runner who made debut in richer company when seventh at Randwick Kensington. Resuming in easier and fitter for two jump-outs. Big watch. DIAMOND MILA (2) has ability and drawn for a good run. LOST THE PLOT (6) made a nice return here last time and expected to run well.
